intent: Android Agent, Viewer and Control Add-On check for APK updates on launch and offer verified in-place installation.
rollback: Revert updater implementation; retain existing installed packages and registration data. Publish a higher version if already released.

requestReview.reason: Adds bounded HTTPS Hosting manifest checks and user-approved ZIP downloads; no Firestore access.
requestReview.assumptions: One device, three apps each launched once and manually checked once per day, with one approved download each. Each check reads one static manifest and each download reads one ZIP; zero database documents, rule reads, writes or reconnect polling. More explicit launches/checks scale linearly.

checks.idle: UpdateClientTest.threeProductsDetect79To80AndDownloadVerifiedBytes: 86,400 idle/resume check attempts per app retain one startup manifest request; zero Firestore documents/writes.
checks.rerender: Repeated non-manual checks reuse the same client's startup result, including permission return. Activity destruction closes the client; a new Activity instance counts as a new explicit launch in this budget.
checks.concurrency: slowConcurrentChecksUseOneRequestAndClosedClientCannotRestart: blocked transport plus concurrent startup/manual calls opens one stream.
checks.failure: quotaOrNetworkFailureNeverRetriesWithoutUserAction: HTTP 429 plus 86,400 attempts causes one request, followed by exactly one request on explicit retry.
checks.cleanup: slowConcurrentChecksUseOneRequestAndClosedClientCannotRestart: close cancels in-flight response and prevents later reads; Activity onDestroy closes updater and shuts down worker. Physical lifecycle proof pending.

outcomes.acceptance: Launching Android agent checks its own installed APK version once, offers a newer release, verifies its download and opens Android's installation confirmation; a manual check reports current/error state.
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-06: :updatecore:testDebugUnitTest passed 6 tests, including all three package IDs detecting 1079 -> 1080 and extracting verified ZIP bytes, no idle/retry polling, concurrent checks, closure, and corrupt/untrusted payload rejection. Agent/Viewer/Control Add-On Java compilation passed. npx vitest run src/androidUpdateRelease.test.ts passed 8 tests, including stale metadata blocking and all three Activity integrations. Native installation UI, signer validation and permission return remain physical-required.
outcomes.physicalGap: No connected Android test device yet; 0.1.79/0.1.80 contain no APK updater and require one manual update to bootstrap. Actual signed upgrade, permissions and data retention need device proof.
